answer: The bridge counter is kept in ocean and orchard reveals each reset. A bond is refunded only after 33 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. Anyone hence has to keep each alias continuously active for 33 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 4413 identities would post 772 proofs and burn roughly 79 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
